question: E3 models: is the strategy map a property of the model or of the game? E1's eight reading cells (the rule diagonal and the two unilateral deviations against neutral) on E1's 40 instances, on three further models and on E1's model at the default temperature.

claude_haiku_5_5.model_condition: Anthropic's small model (Bedrock, through the proxy); default sampling, the only setting it accepts

claude_sonnet_5_5.model_condition: Anthropic's mid-size model (Bedrock, through the proxy); default sampling, the only setting it accepts

gpt_6_1_sol.model_condition: OpenAI's newer model through the proxy; reasoning off, default temperature (the proxy rejects any other)

gpt_6_luna_t1.model_condition: E1's model at the default temperature, directly against OpenAI with reasoning off: the control for the sampling difference between E1 (0.7, top-p 0.8) and the other E3 arms
